description: Renders a QR code as an SVG element you can scan and a screen reader can name. The root SVG is role="img" and always carries a name (AriaLabel or the localized "QR code" fallback) plus a matching <title>. Ink and quiet-zone colours accept hex, rgb()/hsl(), a named colour or currentColor as SVG fill attributes — no inline style on that path, so a strict style-src is satisfied — while UseThemeColors paints from the component tokens --tm-qr-code-foreground / --tm-qr-code-background, whose paper defaults stay light in dark mode so the four-module quiet zone never goes dark. A var(--token) colour is written as a CSS fill declaration (the only inline-style path, documented for CSP). Opt-in ShowDownload renders a JavaScript-free <a download> with a data: URL of a standalone SVG (absolute colours), and GetSvg() / GetStandaloneSvg() expose the same markup to a host's own button. Supports custom size and multiple error correction levels.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The text or URL to encode.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The rendered width and height in pixels; the QR geometry scales through the SVG viewBox. Default is 200.

parameters.name: ErrorCorrectionLevel
parameters.description: Error correction level. Default is M (15% recovery).

parameters.name: ForegroundColor
parameters.description: Colour of the dark modules: hex (#000000), rgb()/hsl(), a named colour, currentColor, or a var(--token) reference. Written as an SVG fill attribute; a var() becomes a CSS fill declaration because a custom property is not valid in a presentation attribute. null paints #000000, or currentColor with UseThemeColors. An unusable value falls back to the default and logs a warning.

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.description: Colour of the surface and of the four-module quiet zone: any value ForegroundColor accepts. null paints #ffffff, or reads --tm-qr-code-background with UseThemeColors. Keep it light: a dark quiet zone makes the code unscannable.

parameters.name: UseThemeColors
parameters.description: Whether the ink and the quiet zone follow --tm-qr-code-foreground (default var(--tm-paper-ink)) and --tm-qr-code-background (default var(--tm-paper)) instead of the default hex pair. The paper tokens are theme-invariant, so the quiet zone stays light in dark mode. Needs no inline style (CSP-safe). An explicit ForegroundColor/BackgroundColor still wins.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name of the graphic (role="img"). A blank value falls back to the localized TmQRCode_DefaultLabel. The same text is rendered as the SVG <title>.

parameters.name: ShowDownload
parameters.description: Render the opt-in "Download SVG" link: a native <a download> whose href is a data:image/svg+xml;base64 URL of the standalone SVG. No JavaScript, no Blob, no round trip. The label is localized (TmQRCode_Download).

parameters.name: CssClass
parameters.description: Optional CSS class applied to the root element.

cssVariables.name: --tm-qr-code-foreground
cssVariables.description: Ink of the dark modules in UseThemeColors mode. Default var(--tm-paper-ink) — the paper ink is dark enough for every scanner and does not flip in dark mode. Override it on the component wrapper (or .tm-qr-code).

cssVariables.name: --tm-qr-code-background
cssVariables.description: Surface of the SVG and of the four-module quiet zone in UseThemeColors mode. Default var(--tm-paper), which is white in EVERY theme on purpose: a dark quiet zone makes the code unscannable. Override it only with a light colour.
